description: PRIORE reference cases. Expected values from the frozen production pipeline (SPARK8_pipeline.joblib); derived values from the development code (FINAL_03 functions extracted verbatim; same-day aggregation from the cleaning script).

rules.same_day_results: averaged before the 30-120 range and window are applied

cases.scenario: low risk; younger female; no medicines
just below 5% (closest below on a realistic integer grid)
just above 5% (closest at/above on a realistic integer grid)
above 5%; female; all three medicine questions yes
two results on the same day are averaged first (50 and 60 -> 55)
same-day average enters the 30-120 range (25 and 35 -> 30, used)
window: 730 days before used; 731 days before, same day and after not used
leap-year window: 2 calendar years = 731 days (not used); 730 days used
previous results below 30 and above 120 not used
current eGFR not a whole number (average of two results on the current day)
previous results exactly 30 and 120 used; 29.5 and 120.5 not used
only one day of previous results (two same-day results count once)

reasons: fewer than 2 days with a usable previous eGFR result

cases.scenario: one previous result inside the 2 years, one outside

reasons: fewer than 2 days with a usable previous eGFR result
fewer than 2 days with a usable previous eGFR result
